warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THE 4 TV OUTLETS MATCH EE-06's DIAGRAM EXACTLY -- a digital aerial into a 4-way splitter in a 4"x4"x2" TV BOX feeding four outlets. *** Both the box size and the outlet count are confirmed, and the 0.90 m mounting height is EE-01's.

*** THE SUB-CATEGORY IS NUMBERED 4.4 HERE, BUT THE แผ่นที่ 21/34 SUB-SUMMARY LISTS THE TV SYSTEM AS 4.3. *** Together with the previous sheet, where the computer system is headed 4.2 but subtotalled as 'รวมข้อ 4.3', the electrical sub-numbering is inconsistent across three sheets. Everything is transcribed as printed; the estimator has to reconcile it.
The aerial and TV BOX are priced as ONE Set, so the splitter EE-06 shows inside the box is not separately measurable.
Cable again exceeds conduit (49 m RG6 against 45 m PVC), the same convention as the computer system.
EE-06's note specifies '1-RG6-in ø15 มม. PVC', exactly what is priced here.
